questions.q: What gives trees their unique personalities?

questions.why: They use root-fungi communication for protection.

questions.q: Why do trees share food with neighbors?
questions.why: They support the forest for mutual survival.

questions.q: What role does the forest community play?
questions.why: Trees rely on community for support.

questions.q: What is the main misconception about trees?
questions.why: Many think trees are passive, but they communicate.
